# 设置远程开门配置
##### 简要描述

- ChannelID固定为1

**XML**字段解释<span lang="EN-US"></span>

| 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| RemoteDoorOpenSwitch | boolean | 远程开门开关,false-禁用;true-启用<span lang="EN-US"></span> | <span lang="EN-US"></span>否 |
| AssociateQRCode | boolean | 是否关联二维码,false-否;true-是<span lang="EN-US"></span> | 否<span lang="EN-US"></span> |
| AssociatedVisitorBodyTemperature | boolean | 是否关联访客体温,false-否;true-是<span lang="EN-US"></span> | 否<span lang="EN-US"></span> |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

``` http
PUT /FaceReco/1/RemoteOpenDoorCfg HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
Content-Type: application/xml
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: e51b88f6-a82d-4494-9a16-ab2c89a8695c
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive
Content-Length: 275

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<RemoteOpenDoorCfg Version="1.0">
<RemoteDoorOpenSwitch>true</RemoteDoorOpenSwitch>
<AssociateQRCode>true</AssociateQRCode>
<AssociatedVisitorBodyTemperature>true</AssociatedVisitorBodyTemperature>
</RemoteOpenDoorCfg>


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Type: application/xml
Connection: close
Content-Length: 195

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<ResponseStatus Version="1.0">
<requestURL>/FaceReco/1/RemoteOpenDoorCfg</requestURL>
<statusCode>0</statusCode>
<message />
</ResponseStatus>
```
